policy: Expected-result-first. This file is an implementation plan only; coverage remains partial until the official Expected Result is proven in the intended store/business path.

quickAssertion.title: Cart page UI
quickAssertion.reason: The controlled cart now asserts SKU, price, thumbnail, available services, order summary and footer. Info-icon coverage and live verification remain.

quickAssertion.title: Order Summary on checkout page
quickAssertion.reason: The guest checkout already reaches Payment and now validates positive subtotal/total price details. Remaining work is live verification and any source-supported detail still not observed.

quickAssertion.title: Sticky checkout button on mobile
quickAssertion.reason: The dedicated mobile test passed in S1 and proves the sticky cart CTA. Add an explicit checkout-page sticky assertion only if the updated official Expected Result requires both surfaces.

existingFlowExtension.title: Verify trade-up cart page
existingFlowExtension.reason: Trade-in UI is already opened. The existing safe storefront flow must complete the add action and verify resulting cart/delete state with MX-specific data before this can be Full.

existingFlowExtension.title: Backoffice
existingFlowExtension.reason: Exact order search/open is proven. Product search and basic/advanced search coverage should extend the existing BackOffice page object rather than create a separate architecture.

existingFlowExtension.title: Facets/Filter
existingFlowExtension.reason: The PreQA2 runner implements real facet selection and observable result comparison. Investigate the live FAIL; do not misclassify it as missing automation.

newBusinessFlow.title: Add product from BC Page
newBusinessFlow.reason: Current path starts from PDP. Official BC-page-origin behavior needs a distinct route/context and should not be simulated by renaming the existing PDP flow.

newBusinessFlow.title: Add SC+ from BC/PDP Page
newBusinessFlow.reason: SC+ add itself is proven, but the official BC/PDP-origin journey still needs the WMC/PreQA storefront context.

newBusinessFlow.title: Able to add/edit new/saved address
newBusinessFlow.reason: Registered checkout exists, but save/edit/change of persisted addresses requires stateful registered-address behavior not currently exercised.

newBusinessFlow.title: Able to checkout with a New address
newBusinessFlow.reason: Current flow proves a new shipping address only. Shipping plus billing-address behavior must be exercised explicitly.

eppContext.title: Able to add to Cart from PDP
eppContext.reason: Base Store PDP behavior is proven, but the official case belongs to EPP and cannot be promoted without running in EPP context.

eppContext.title: Cart page UI
eppContext.reason: Core cart behavior exists in Base Store, but this official case requires EPP execution plus complete official cart UI assertions.

eppContext.title: Step 1: Contact information
eppContext.reason: Contact information is proven in Base Store, but the official case is EPP and needs EPP store context.

eppContext.title: Payment using credit card with reg user
eppContext.reason: Registered credit-card order is proven in Base Store, but the official case is EPP and needs EPP order placement.
